goal: Decouple indexes from node validation locks to prevent lock contention and improve responsiveness
Eliminate race conditions during reindexing and enable running indexes in separate processes
reviewability: Needs rebase due to merge conflicts with master before code review is worthwhile
agreement: Strong support for decoupling indexes and eliminating lock contention
Approach approval despite the daunting length of the changeset (sedited)
Verified decoupling motivations through detailed commit-by-commit review (jamesob)
Concept approval for the overall design (fjahr, mzumsande, aureleoules, josibake)
Some concern over large patch size with suggestions to split off race fixes into standalone PRs

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because it removes lock contention during index synchronization and improves node responsiveness
It also eliminates startup race conditions that can occur during chainstate reindexing

categories.name: ipc
why: P2 because it unblocks running index subsystems as independent components in separate processes
Allows indexing clients to operate cleanly across process boundaries

categories.name: kernel
why: P3 because it cleans up the kernel boundary by moving interface-only data structures out of the kernel
Benefit is limited to code organization without direct performance or stability impact
